name: Stage 5:3: Hemfosa to Etapp 6 (1 km från Paradiset)
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 5:3, Hemfosa to Etapp 6 (1 km från Paradiset).
utilities: Official area: Haninge Kommun, Huddinge kommun, Nynäshamns Kommun, Stockholm.
Hemfosa station is the practical rail access, but the official stage start is about 1 km west by road at Hemfosavägen.
Mid-route access is possible near Sofielund/Sorundavägen by bus when service is running; check SL because service can be sparse.

The official stage ends at the Etapp 6 junction about 1 km south of Paradiset. Paradiset has large parking, toilet, water pump, shelter/rest area, and bus access via Bruket or Ådran, but those facilities are technically on the Etapp 6 continuation.

Hjälmsätersvägen and Sofielund can be useful road/bus access points around Österby/Sorundavägen, while Västra skolan and Slåboda are separate Tornberget reserve access points rather than direct Stage 5:3 finishes.
No grocery, cafe, restaurant, or resupply was verified on core Stage 5:3. Tungelsta services are well off-route and should be treated as a separate transport/detour plan, not stage infrastructure.

Check SL the same day for Hemfosa commuter-rail service and bus 848/709 access. Line 848 serves Sofielund/Sorundavägen seasonally/sparsely, and line 709 serves Bruket/Ådran for Paradiset exits. Stored timetable PDFs valid into 2026 still need live verification.
waterSources: No reliable potable water was verified on core 5:3. Carry water and treat/filter any natural lake water.

Paradiset water pump is the strongest verified refill, but it sits about 0.6-1.0 km beyond the official 5:3 endpoint on the Etapp 6 continuation and should still be treated as self-responsibility water rather than a tested municipal guarantee.
Transjön, Vädersjön, Vedasjön, Tornbergssjön, and other lakes/streams are natural water only. Third-party shelter data describes Transjön water as unknown quality; filter/boil and carry backup.
Older comments mention a source/pump around 5.5 km with bad taste/smell and no bacterial testing; do not mark it as dependable drinking water without fresh verification.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official Sörmlandsleden lists 5:3 as Hemfosa to Etapp 6, 1 km from Paradiset, 15 km, with the page modified 2026-01-26. OSM/Naturkartan/Äventyrligare/AllTrails and older community sources often label the practical route as Hemfosa-Paradiset or Hemfosa-Tornberget and may include the Hemfosa station approach, Paradiset continuation, or older naming.

For route drawing, prefer the official full-line GPX/OSM/Naturkartan geometry that ends at the 5:3/Etapp 6/Tornbergsslingan junction around 59.148530, 18.018296. The official public GPX segment measures about 14.1 km and OSM about 14.4 km, while the official catalog distance is 15 km; show 15 km as canonical and treat map length as approximate.

OSM relation 2343975 is geometrically useful but its `to=Paradiset` tag is misleading relative to the current official endpoint. OSM Etapp 6 relation 2343842 carries the roughly 0.85-1.0 km continuation from the 5:3 junction to Paradiset; keep that as a connector rather than merging it into Stage 5:3.

Hemfosa station access is a separate roughly 1.0-1.1 km connector and should not be snapped into the canonical Stage 5:3 distance. The Paradiset continuation via Etapp 6 is also a separate connector; AllTrails/TopoGPS/Wikiloc-style Hemfosa-Paradiset tracks are useful extended-trip variants, not the stage boundary.

Österby nature reserve has an active bark-beetle/dead-spruce warning: trees can fall suddenly even without obvious warning, especially in wind, and Länsstyrelsen says the Sörmlandsleden path in the reserve is no longer maintained by them. Sörmlandsleden's 2024-12-01 fault report and 2025 comments describe fallen trees, orange-tape detours, crawling/climbing obstacles, and passable but awkward conditions. Avoid this reserve section in windy weather and do not climb unstable windthrows.

Expect varied forest, lakes, hällmark, wetter low areas, open fields near Hjälmsättra, some road walking, and the Tornberget tower. Vädersjön and other low/wet areas can be slow after rain or snowmelt; older reports mention flooded trail, slippery duckboards, mud, bugs, dense growth, roots, stones, and windfall obstacles. Treat those as condition signals rather than exact current defects.

Road 257/Väländan-area road walking can have heavy traffic and imperfect/missing signage in comments. Trafikverket work on 257/Tungelstavägen runs into summer 2027; keep the map handy and use care around road margins and crossings.

Fires in the reserve landscape should stay at prepared fireplaces and never on bare rock, cliffs, or slabs. Österby, Tornberget, and Paradiset rules prohibit damaging living or dead trees, so do not collect deadwood for fuel. Check current fire-ban status; no firewood is guaranteed at shelters.

Tornberget and Paradiset reserve rules require dogs and other pets not to run loose. From 1 March to 20 August, Swedish national dog rules require extra strict control in nature; using a lead is the safer default on this stage.

Österby, Tornberget, and Paradiset include Natura 2000 or sensitive old-forest/wetland values. Stay on marked paths where practical, keep noise and dog disturbance low, and avoid trampling wetland or shore vegetation.

Paradiset reserve allows short tenting under local rules if vegetation is not damaged and you avoid agricultural land/hay meadows, but verify signs on site. Huddinge guidance describes one, maximum two, nights; Transjön shelter is first-come, small, and not bookable.

Paradiset parking and firewood are convenience context, not guarantees. Local reports describe popular lots and firewood sometimes being gone; transit-first planning and carrying a stove are more reliable.

facilities.name: Hemfosa station access
facilities.description: Commuter rail access about 1 km east of the official stage start; no shop, toilet, or tap was verified at the station.

facilities.name: Hemfosa / Hemfosavägen stage start
facilities.description: Official 5:3 start and small parking/access area on Hemfosavägen; official text says about 6-8 cars. Hemfosa station is a separate road connector east of here.

facilities.name: Official GPX 5:3 endpoint
facilities.description: Endpoint derived from Sörmlandsleden's public full-line GPX, matching the Etapp 6 junction about 1 km before Paradiset. This coordinate is derived from GPX geometry rather than printed as an official endpoint coordinate.

facilities.name: Transjön shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter reached by a short spur after the stage start. Third-party shelter data suggests roughly 4-5 sleeping places, benches/fireplace, possible tent space, swimming, and unknown-quality water; no toilet or potable water was verified.

facilities.name: Transjön shelter fireplace
facilities.description: Firepit at the Transjön shelter area; check fire bans and do not assume firewood.

facilities.name: Transjön natural water
facilities.description: Lake water only; not a verified potable refill. Shelter-map data describes water quality as unknown. Treat/filter/boil and avoid contaminating the shore.

facilities.name: Österby dead-spruce warning zone
facilities.description: Active official fault area: bark-beetle-damaged spruce and fallen trees can make the route awkward and dangerous, especially in wind. Länsstyrelsen says dead standing spruce can fall suddenly and that the Sörmlandsleden path in the reserve is no longer maintained by them; follow orange-tape detours where marked.

facilities.name: Österby reserve and Natura rules
facilities.description: Österby/Engården sensitive old-forest and mire context: do not damage rock, soil, living or dead trees, shrubs, mosses, lichens, or wood-living fungi. Avoid off-trail detours through dead-spruce areas and wetland edges.

facilities.name: Norrudden road parking
facilities.description: Small parking/access option near the road toward Norrudden; official text says only a couple of cars.

facilities.name: Hjälmsätersvägen bus access
facilities.description: Bus access for Österby/Norrudden area; Naturkartan describes about 400 m walk to reserve parking/info. Check SL 848 live because service varies.

facilities.name: Sofielund bus access
facilities.description: Mid-route bus access near Sorundavägen. Check current SL service before relying on it.

facilities.name: Vädersjön bird lake and wetland risk
facilities.description: Bird-lake/wetland area mentioned by official text. Seasonal flooding, 20-30 m of flooded trail, and slippery duckboards have been reported; not a drinking-water source.

facilities.name: Vädersjön flooded-boardwalk warning
facilities.description: Seasonal wet-area warning from official comments and trail reviews. Rubber boots or careful detours may be needed after high water or heavy rain.

facilities.name: Vedasjön natural water
facilities.description: Lake followed by the route after Väländan; treat as natural/untested water only.

facilities.name: Road 257 / Väländan road caution
facilities.description: Road-walk/crossing caution near the Väländan/Tornberget approach. Hiker comments mention heavy traffic and sometimes confusing signage, and Trafikverket work on 257/Tungelstavägen runs into summer 2027; use care.

facilities.name: Västra skolan Tornberget access
facilities.description: Bus access for Tornberget reserve, requiring extra road walking. Useful for bailout/access planning but not a core Stage 5:3 facility.

facilities.name: Tornbergssjön rock rest area
facilities.description: Officially mentioned rest rocks near Tornbergssjön; OSM also maps nearby picnic/fire context. Natural lake/rest area, not a potable water source.

facilities.name: Tornbergssjön firepit
facilities.description: Mapped BBQ/firepit near Tornbergssjön rest context. Use only where signed/permitted, never on bare rock, and only when current fire rules allow.

facilities.name: Slåboda / Tornberget access parking
facilities.description: Separate Tornberget reserve access parking via Road 257, not the Stage 5:3 endpoint. Useful for bailouts or side access; OSM/Haninge context suggests only a small gravel lot.

facilities.name: Tornberget area fireplace
facilities.description: Mapped fireplace near the Tornberget area; treat as nonofficial unless confirmed on site. Reserve rules still prohibit fires on bare rock and current fire bans override use.

facilities.name: Tornberget tower and benches
facilities.description: Tornbergstornet, a 10 m lookout tower on Stockholm County's highest point, with tables/benches nearby.

facilities.name: Tornberget stove/table area
facilities.description: Rest area by the tower. Naturkartan/Haninge context notes tables/benches and metal surfaces for camp stoves/field grills; use prepared/robust surfaces only and never fire directly on rock.

facilities.name: Tornberget reserve rules
facilities.description: Core Stage 5:3 reserve/Natura context: dogs/pets must not run loose; do not damage living or dead trees, disturb wildlife, collect invertebrates, ride except on designated roads, or light fires on bare rock/cliffs.

facilities.name: Etapp 6 junction south of Paradiset
facilities.description: Official 5:3 endpoint and topology fork: north/northeast continues on Etapp 6 toward Paradiset services, west/southwest continues Etapp 6 toward Lida, and south returns on 5:3 toward Hemfosa/Tornberget.

facilities.name: Stage 5:3 endpoint label caveat
facilities.description: OSM relation 2343975 and some third-party sources label the destination Paradiset, but current official Sörmlandsleden ends Stage 5:3 here at the Etapp 6 junction. Treat Paradiset as continuation/access, not the section endpoint.

facilities.name: Naturkartan Stage 5:3 title caveat
facilities.description: Naturkartan labels the item Hemfosa-Tornberget and about 14.5 km. That matches mapped geometry more than official catalog distance, but Tornberget is a highlight/area rather than the official endpoint.

facilities.name: Paradiset / Etapp 6 official start
facilities.description: Official Etapp 6/Paradiset start area, reached by continuing north from the 5:3 endpoint. This is continuation context, not the canonical Stage 5:3 endpoint.

facilities.name: Paradiset water pump
facilities.description: Verified pump at Paradiset on the Etapp 6 continuation, about 0.6-1.0 km beyond the official 5:3 endpoint. Strongest refill near the route, but Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water testing/quality.

facilities.name: Paradiset toilet
facilities.description: Toilet/outhouse area at Paradiset, useful on the continuation or as an endpoint service.

facilities.name: Paradiset grill and raststuga
facilities.description: Continuation-service cluster at Paradiset with grill/rest-house context, bins, outhouse, and pump/well nearby. Opening and firewood availability are not guaranteed; fire bans override use.

facilities.name: Paradiset shelter/rest area
facilities.description: Shelter/rest area at Paradiset on Etapp 6, not on the core official 5:3 section.

facilities.name: Paradiset entrance parking
facilities.description: Large Paradiset parking/entrance area for those using the Etapp 6 continuation as the practical endpoint. It can be busy, so do not assume space without a fallback.

facilities.name: Paradiset reserve wetland rules
facilities.description: Paradiset/Hanveden continuation context includes sensitive lakes, bogs, fens, wooded bog, old forest, and swamp-forest values. Keep to marked routes where practical, leash pets, and avoid wetland or shore trampling when camping/resting.

facilities.name: Bruket bus 709 Paradiset access
facilities.description: Bus 709 access for Paradiset via the signed road approach. Sparse service; check SL live before relying on it as an exit.

facilities.name: Ådran bus 709 Paradiset access
facilities.description: Sparse bus access for the Paradiset continuation area; Sörmlandsleden says Ådran is closer than Bruket but check SL live before using it as an exit.

facilities.name: Ugglekojan / Trehörningen continuation lodging
facilities.description: Nearby Paradiset/Trehörningen lodging/shelter context off the strict 5:3 endpoint corridor. Useful for overnight planning only if deliberately continuing beyond Stage 5:3.
